instruction: Can you disable the 'one instance when started from file' setting in VLC? I prefer to have each media file open in its own separate VLC window so I can manage multiple videos simultaneously.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the 'one instance when started from file' option in VLC. Uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric function to verify the setting is disabled (set to 0) in the VLC configuration file.
